thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may treat LAND as a passive high-yield REIT whose dividend is fully covered by recurring rent, missing the portfolio rotation and lease-repositioning story underway in 2025–2026. **[Fact]** Management sold **13 farms** (**12,502** acres) for **~$95.4 million** in FY2025, recognizing **~$21.3 million** of net gains, and modified leases on "Repositioned Farms" to trade lower fixed base rent for higher participation on permanent crops (including a **~$4.9 million** pistachio bonus payment in Q1 2026). **[Inference]** At **~$9.23** (June 10, 2026), the stock trades at roughly **44%** below GAAP book equity of **~$16.50** per share, a discount consistent with small-cap REIT yield-screen exclusion and concern that the monthly dividend exceeds normalized cash earnings. **[Inference]** Predictive attribute: **farmland lease REIT** plus **market structure discount** (externally managed, preferred equity layer, monthly payout cadence).

open_questions: External adviser fee stack (**0.60%** base + incentive above **7%** hurdle): compare total cost to self-managed farmland REIT peers before stance upgrade.
Q1 2026 ATM issuance (**3.7M** shares, **~$36.7M** net): confirm use of proceeds and pause if AFFO coverage does not improve.
Preferred equity (Series B/C): common equity sits behind **~$15.7M** preferred at 3/31/2026; model fully diluted economics.
No third-party farmland NAV appraisal in base case; per-acre marks require independent comp work.
